resources.string: Protection is on while the device is locked. Keep System UI and System Framework checked in Vector\'s scope: System Framework is what blocks the power menu.
Enable NoLockQS in Vector for System UI and System Framework, then reboot.
NoLockQS blocks the Quick Settings panel and the power menu while your device is locked, so connectivity toggles and power controls can\'t be used without unlocking.
Works on rooted Google Pixel phones running Android 15 or newer, with Vector 2.2 or another libxposed API 101+ framework.
This app does not collect any data and runs locally on your device.
